simple.meaning: מַעֲכָה (Maʻăkâh) appears 23 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Joshua, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 22:24. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַעֲכָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
definitions.full: H4601. Maakah or Maakath מַעֲכָה proper name, masculine, feminine and of a people 1. masculine ᵐ5 Μ ( ο ) ωχα , Μα ( α ) χα : a. son of Nahor by his concubine רְאוּמָה Gen 22:22 (J), ancestor of people see 3. b. father of חָנָן , a hero of David 1Chr 11:43 . c. Simeonite name 1Chr 27:16 . d. father of Achish 1Kin 2:39 (see מָעוֺךְ above). 2. feminine ᵐ5 Μ ( ο ) ωχα , Μααχα, etc.: a. Geshurite princess, wife of David, mother of Absalom , 2Sam 3:3 = 1Chr 3:2 . b. daughter of Absalom, wife of Rehoboam, mother of Abijam , 1Kin 15:2 ; 2Chr 11:20-21 , 22 ; read also ׳מ 13:2 (so ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ) for מִיכָיָה ᵑ0 , where called daughter of Uriel of Gibeah (on this difficulty see Be Öttli, and compare c ). c. mother of Asa, and called also daughter of Absalom (as b ) 1Kin 15:10 , compare 15:13 2Chr 15:16 , (on this difficulty see Th Kmp: in Kau). d. concubine of Caleb according to 1Chr 2:48 . e. wife of Machir 1Chr 7:16 , compare 7:15 (corrupt, see Be). f. wife of ( יעיאל ), father of Gibeon, 1Chr 8:29 ; 9:35 . 3. of a people , ᵐ5 Μοοχα , Μωχα , Μα ( α ) χα ; dwelling west of Bashan, near Soba , and Geshur (compare especially adjective, of a people below), 2Sam 10:6 , 8 = 1Chr 19:7 , מ ׳אֲרַם 19:6 (compare Gen 22:24 above); = מַעֲכָת Josh 13:13 (+ גְּשׁוּר ), ᵐ5 ὀ Μαχατει , Μαχαθι . — מַעֲכָה בֵּית אָבֵל see below בַּיִת , p. 112 above, and אָבֵל , p. 5. מַעֲכָת see above מַעֲכָה 3
